checks: Nine focused Dolphin controls and seven reused pragmatic-schema checks; unchanged concurrency case passes ten consecutive repeats after bounded bootstrap-lease fix, see model.md#tests.
cost: O(N log N) deterministic ranking, bounded96token/12000byte request validation, serialized SQLite metadata; report cap128000bytes. No measured speedup claim.
description: Pure low-priority independent annotation audit reservation/report adapter with finite sentence quota and separate review-only revisions.
forward: Read-only eligible teacher snapshot -> deterministic unseen bounded sentence -> serialized lifetime reservation -> caller consultation outside this module -> revision-bound report validation or quarantine in a separate audit queue.
inverse: Behavior complement excludes reservations above the explicit finite quota, replay of pending IDs and automatic training admission.
Archived source/review hashes constrain compatible revision histories but do not reconstruct hidden consultation or prove linguistic truth; a reservation does not imply dispatch.
limitations: Trusted eligible source versions and SQLite/storage semantics assumed. One persistent run-root lifetime; source shrink/fraction reduction can expose existing breach. Caller must arbitrate foreground/idle priority. No gold annotation or arbitrary-crash proof.
state: Automatic audit disabled by default. Default0.5percent/max1percent lifetime sentence cap per persistent queue; at most one pending; no teacher/terminal/training invocation or main DB writes.
